description: Row counts m of a float32 [m, 4096] @ [4096, 4096] product. The KernelBench level 1 square (problem 1) and standard (problem 2) matmuls both include exactly this 4096^3 case; the other row counts span the sizes those problems, the irregular-shape problem 8 and the rocm-examples HIP matrix multiplication use for m (16 to 8205), at the fixed n = k = 4096. Rows 64 to 8192 are timed (128x); 16, 48, 100, 4099 and 8205 are correctness-only boundary shapes.
